about:
Based in Houston, Texas, OEM Components Inc has spent five decades supplying high-performance sealing technology to the oil and gas industry. The company was established as a manufacturer of original equipment components, though the exact founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company manufactures machined components, high-technology specialty seals, and related oilfield product designs, with a focus on surface and subsurface drilling and completion seal systems. OEM pioneered and patented ECNER wire mesh sealing technology and holds several design patents. It also provides seal design, component and product engineering, and turn-key manufacturing services including engineering design and supply, sub-assemblies, and complete assemblies built to customer drawings and specifications.

OEM serves the oil and gas industry, providing sealing solutions for aggressive downhole conditions and high-temperature, high-pressure (HTHP) applications. Its customer base includes operators and contractors requiring reliable sealing systems for drilling and completion operations.

The company emphasizes design innovation, reliability, and quality, backed by a stable supply base secured through broad industry contacts. Its mission centers on delivering the best products through the latest technological advances, meeting client requirements with on-time deliveries while conforming to all quality and documentation standards.
